tweet.text:
in 2022 I roundtripped most of my gains that I made

it was easily the lowest point in my life

fast forward two years and my port is at all time high and more

I didn't make it all back in one trade

I made it all back in thousands of trades

the goal here is to win more than you lose

most people try to run up bags crazy quick and end up blowing up their entire account

if you walk away from this cycle with life changing money for you, you will be better off than most people

many people who are reading this are either going to lose it all by making mistakes or will simply roundtrip 

and that's the cost of tuition

coming up with your own plan and securing profits over the next few months will be the best thing you do

take your bets, make big money, and make sure to secure it

surround yourself with the right people and you will do well this cycle

we've got some good times ahead fam
